Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), [[and ]]a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant, wherein the modified live BVDV-lb virus is distinct from any BVDV-lb virus described in WO 2007/117303.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus that is not disclosed in WO 2007/117303.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the combination does not include components solely derived from WO 2007/117303.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein at least one of the modified viruses is not described in WO 2007/117303.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen that is not disclosed in WO 2007/117303.

Claim 7 (Original): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

Claim 8 (Original): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim [[11]]4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen that is not derived from WO 2007/117303.
